meta.title: MessMate BD — every bachelor account, in one app
meta.homeTitle: MessMate BD — the all-in-one life platform for bachelors in Dhaka
meta.description: Meals, bazar, bills and wallet for your mess; housing, roommates and services; and someone in your corner on the days you live alone — built for bachelors in Dhaka.

hero.badge: Built for messes, flats and sublets in Dhaka
hero.subtitle: Meals, bazar, bills and wallet — from finding a seat to matching a roommate — plus someone in your corner on the days you live far from family. In Bangla and English.
hero.note: Completely free · Bangla and English · Installs on your phone like an app

ledger.title: Not a taka goes missing
ledger.body: Every transaction lives in a ledger nobody can quietly edit.

isolated.title: Every mess is separate
isolated.body: No other mess can see anything from yours.

bangla.title: Bangla first
bangla.body: The whole app in Bangla, English one tap away.

manager.title: Less work for managers
manager.body: Meal rate, bill splits and month-end accounts happen on their own.

features.title: Your mess notebook, now in your pocket
features.subtitle: No more counting meals in a diary, splitting bills on a calculator, or "did you pay?" in the group chat.

meals.title: Meals and bazar
meals.body: Daily menu, switch meals on or off before cutoff, guest meals, and bazar costs with receipts.

wallet.title: Prepaid wallet
wallet.body: Pay by bKash, Nagad, Rocket or cash and submit the TrxID; your manager checks and approves it.

bills.title: Bills and month-end
bills.body: Rent, electricity, gas, wifi, bua salary — split equally, by room or your way. A statement every month.

housing.title: Housing and roommates
housing.body: Find seats, rooms, flats and sublets by area. Match with roommates who fit your habits.

daily.title: Running the mess
daily.body: Complaint box, bazar duty roster, polls and a notice board — out in the open, for everyone.

services.title: Services and marketplace
services.body: Local bua, tiffin, electricians, plumbers and gas — plus buying and selling second-hand fans and tables.

care.title: Living alone, but not alone
care.subtitle: Living in Dhaka away from family is hard. Nobody knows when you have a fever, nobody checks when you're late home, and money runs out before the month does. This part is for those days.

sick.title: Sick mode
sick.body: Tell your messmates you're unwell in one tap — and whether you need light food, medicine or a doctor.

sos.title: SOS
sos.body: Send an emergency message with your location to the people you trust.

checkin.title: Reached home
checkin.body: Set when you expect to be home at night. Miss your check-in and your friends are alerted.

mood.title: How are you, really
mood.body: A daily mood check-in, and helplines to talk to on the hard days.

family.title: Call home
family.body: A gentle nudge when it's been a while since you called home. Meetups for when you're in Dhaka over Eid or Puja.

survival.title: Month-end survival
survival.body: A budget, a record of what friends owe, cheap recipes, and tuition and part-time leads.

care.note: Care features help you reach friends — they are not an emergency service. In danger, always call 999.

create.title: Create your mess
create.body: The manager sets up the mess in a minute — area, address and meal rules.

invite.title: Share the code
invite.body: Send the 8-character code or link on WhatsApp. Members request to join and the manager approves.

relax.title: The app does the rest
relax.body: Meals, bazar, bills and wallet stay up to date; the meal rate and statements are ready at month end.

money.q: Does the app move real money?
money.a: No. You still pay your manager by bKash, Nagad, Rocket or cash. In the app you only submit the record with the TrxID; once the manager checks and approves it, it shows in your wallet.

privacy.a: Only people in your mess see your name, phone and room; only you and your manager see your transactions. No other mess sees anything. Your mood and Care data are yours alone.

free.a: It's completely free. No ads and no hidden charges.

install.q: Is there a Play Store app?
install.a: You don't need one. Open it in your browser and tap "Add to Home Screen" — it sits on your phone like any other app.

manager.q: How is the meal rate calculated?
manager.a: The manager picks one of two rules: auto (the month's bazar cost ÷ total meals, with breakfast counting as half a meal) or fixed (a set price per meal, charged when you order).

cta.title: Make your mess accounts painless today
cta.body: Create a mess, share the code, and forget the month-end arguments about who owes what.

footer.tagline: For bachelors in Dhaka — meals, money, housing and a little care.
